notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Minor bugfixes.

New cutscene for level 6.

Improved parallax effect in the background on some levels.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
New features:
---------------
-ROBO VISION: Added an ability to look ahead and see the level (Default key: Y)
-STATS: Added end of level screen showing stats (deaths, speed and time)
-LEVEL SELECT: Improved the level select screen, adding more information including stats

Balance improvements:
-------------------------
-Cave boss on level 10 health nerfed (-300hp)
-Platforms on level 13 and 18 made slower and more forgiving
-Mech on level 35 shield nerfed (-300hp)
-Dr. Fine Albaws on level 53 health and damage nerfed (-200hp)

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
-Locked the doors on a few boss levels.
-Level 12: added a sign to explain the energy recharge mechanic.
-Level 13: small change to a slope.
